# altovisas.com
#
# Everything public here is meant to be read, by people and by machines alike.
# The dataset and its caveats are the point of the site, and an assistant that
# summarises them for a student is doing the job we built it for.
#
# Two groups below, with identical rules. The first covers every crawler. The
# second names the answer engines explicitly: several of them look for their own
# token first, and a few (Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended) exist only as an
# opt-out signal, where naming them with an Allow states intent unambiguously.
#
# The disallowed paths are signed-in or mid-flow screens. They render nothing
# useful to a crawler and would be a dead end for anyone arriving from a search
# result.
#
# Deliberately NOT listed: the admin panel. robots.txt is public, so naming a
# private path here would advertise it to exactly the people who should not find
# it. Authentication is what protects it.

User-agent: *
Allow: /
Disallow: /login
Disallow: /signup
Disallow: /forgot-password
Disallow: /chat
Disallow: /choose-level
Disallow: /voice-interview
Disallow: /answers
Disallow: /api/

User-agent: GPTBot
User-agent: ChatGPT-User
User-agent: OAI-SearchBot
User-agent: ClaudeBot
User-agent: Claude-User
User-agent: Claude-SearchBot
User-agent: PerplexityBot
User-agent: Perplexity-User
User-agent: Google-Extended
User-agent: Applebot
User-agent: Applebot-Extended
User-agent: Bingbot
User-agent: DuckDuckBot
User-agent: YandexBot
Allow: /
Disallow: /login
Disallow: /signup
Disallow: /forgot-password
Disallow: /chat
Disallow: /choose-level
Disallow: /voice-interview
Disallow: /answers
Disallow: /api/

Sitemap: https://www.altovisas.com/sitemap.xml
